card.name: The V in anti-viral and vandetanib
card.fires_on: The letter V ("-V", " v", "-v") that starts a word after "Anti" or "anti" in "Anti-Viral Medications". It also fires on " v" at the start of "vandetanib" in drug interaction lists.

modes.label: Anti-Viral heading
modes.description: The "-V" or "-v" piece that follows "Anti" in the phrase anti-viral medications, in statin interaction sections.
modes.example: Intervention: Concomitant use of cyclosporine or gemfibrozil with atorvastatin calcium is not recommended. Anti<<-V>>iral Medications

modes.label: Start of vandetanib
modes.description: The " v" that begins vandetanib in a list of transporter inhibitors after ranolazine.
modes.example: organic cationic transporter-2 [OCT2] / multidrug and toxin extrusion [MATE] inhibitors such as ranolazine,<< v>>andetanib, dolutegr
